name: @repo/auth
//exports: No patch kind edits an exports map, so entries a feature module fills are declared here up front. './access' is filled by teams (src/access.ts, the permission vocabulary), './tenant' by multitenant (src/tenant.ts, requireTenant and the resolver table) and './rbac' by rbac (src/rbac.ts, requireCan). Until each module is installed its subpath resolves to nothing and nothing imports it.
